name: Microbial EOR
principle: Microbes or their nutrients are injected to lower interfacial tension, reduce viscosity, plug thief zones or generate gas. A 1995 survey of 322 US projects found 81% raised production; the Alton field (Australia) reported a 40% increase in 12 months; cost is cited below $10 per incremental barrel.
